intent: Fix run --spawn SIGTERM forwarding race and restore its end-to-end test

name: run --spawn shutdown hook
role: Waits for the child start result before forwarding termination and waiting for child shutdown.
conditions: The publication wait and the child stop wait are each bounded by the configured stop timeout; a failed start completes the handoff exceptionally.

subject: Child publication race
why: A child can run before ProcessBuilder.start returns, so a shutdown hook that reads a null reference and exits can leave it unsignalled.

title: Wait for child publication during shutdown
why: The hook must remain alive until the child is published or startup fails so it can forward termination across the process-start window.
alternative: Read an atomic child reference once — rejected: the hook can complete before the start thread publishes the child.
